Frontend (What the user sees): React.js. This is a JavaScript library for building the user interface.

Backend (The engine): Python/Flask. This runs on your server, handles the logic, and talks to the APIs.

Cache (The fast memory): Redis. This is a separate, specialized database service that your Python backend will talk to.

No messy code generation, just clean, well-structured code. No emojis, no fluff.
